executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca, not a vague visibility problem.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca appears in 19 monitored scenarios where Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Family-Friendly at 25.9% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers. Softest Scenario Capture is Celebration at 28.6%. Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca most often appears when the hotel is missing (19 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Celebration is the softest Scenario Capture at 28.6%. Focus where the gap is concentrated rather than treating every territory equally. Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca appears most often when the hotel is missing (19 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 20.0% (1 of 5 attributes).

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on the demand contexts where Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca is consistently surfaced instead of Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change.

What to Review Next. Open the underlying displacement evidence for Castillo Hotel Son Vida, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Mallorca and compare attributes cited in those answers with Sheraton Mallorca Arabella Golf Hotel's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
